reviews.text: It's honestly great, and an extreme amount of replay value for the price. It is what it says on the tin - it's GTA 1/2 to a tee. Nothing like blowing up an oil tanker that also explodes a school bus sending children everywhere that the SWAT Team gun down as a drunken Santa with a shotgun. It also has wonderful ultrawide support! Get the game, man!

看错了。 一看商店描述是“GTA遇上Vampire Rising”，我想着那不得好玩到爆啊，就果断入手了，结果打开发现味道不对，仔细一看原来是“GTA遇上Vampire Survivors”。 小品级的游戏，简单而言就是GTA被通缉的部分单独拿出来做了一款俯视角游戏，玩家在开局就是被通缉的状态，警方会不断派出警车、直升机等追逐和射击玩家，玩家撞击市民、车辆等行为会导致升星，升星之后追击力量会变得更加强大，游戏目标是在通缉状态下坚持20分钟或者通缉涨到满星。 游戏没有剧情也没有可互动的元素，玩法就是在随机生成的城市地图里抢车或者射击，捡取刷出来的升级道具提升能力，通过撞人撞车和破怪场景来涨通缉度，最后实现目标。 总体而言算是一款简单的解压小游戏吧，游戏里追车的部分做的还是很爽快的，撞击和爆炸效果都不错，除了玩法稍微单调以及初期总在被追击几乎没有还手之力外，算是一款不错的小游戏，可以玩，但是别抱太高期待。

I thought I'd better buy this game before my government bans it (I'm Australian, you know how my government's censorship board is about these things) but as it turns out, I wasn't missing much. The irony of this game is that while a GTA distilled down to just the chasing seems like a good idea in theory, in practice I was actually missing the more chill "just driving around" parts that gave the early GTA games some structure (before the more recent of those games disappeared into endless subquest/cutscene hell). As it happens, a driving game that is ALL destruction is just as boring as a game which has none at all. Also the top down perspective (which is all you get - don't let the trailers fool you) doesn't work that well in this type of game for exactly the same reason it never worked that well in GTA 1 and 2 - as soon as you get into a cool vehicle with any kind of speed, you don't have enough time to react to obstacles, so you end up with no choice about how much carnage you create. It's like the game is punishing you for going fast. I want to CHOOSE whether to run over the lady pushing a pram or not, not have the game choose for me. There's a reason why GTA3 was a much bigger hit than the first two games - you could actually see where you were going and make decisions because you had a driver's perspective of the road. There's no decision making in this game at all beyond timing your switching of vehicles and picking from (very limited) upgrades, so the thrill of the carnage wears off quickly without anything bigger to care about.

[h1]《Maniac》：意想不到的混乱游乐场[/h1] 刚开始我还以为能够让我找回那种之前游玩《Grand Theft Auto: Chinatown Wars》的感觉（2.5D，俯视视角），但实际上也并不完全是——因为本作融入了让我意想不到的类幸存者要素，没错，本作就是这样大胆，在GTA那样的都市犯罪题材，融合了类幸存者的玩法，这样的战斗体验是出奇的富有爽感了。 [h1]欢迎来到Maniac！[/h1] 本作节奏非常刺激明快，毕竟这个城市都有种混乱的疯狂的基调（如果你开始你的行动的话），游戏中给出了六名精神病患者（也就是可游玩角色），他们有着各自的技能，各样的装备，甚至是在混乱进行中的时候，你还可以找到地图中各个地方都有可能出现的补给（对，还是三选一），大街上也是非常应景，为你准备了包括推土机、公共汽车、警车、坦克在内的一系列神奇车辆，当然本作也有着车损的机制，反正就是要让自己在警察的重重包围下更好地活下去！ 哦对啦，本作也有着警星（通缉度）的机制，反正就是要让自己存活得更久——毕竟在警车、坦克、飞机遍地跑的情况，这个挑战足够刺激！ [h1]丰富的游戏设计[/h1] 本作保障游玩体验也有着诸多的设计，开车手感很不错，刚开始选择角色的时候也可以购买一些武器、技能等等，也是很有类幸存者的风格的，而且虽说本作的镜头设置也很有趣，特效也都在线，可以说是在俯视视角下，能够保障玩家的游戏顺利进行，视觉效果也很棒，玩家需要做到的就是要让自己活到核弹被投掷下来的那一刻——这就需要抢车、跑路、获取道具等等方面一气呵成，笔者表示真的很享受这样的融合，特别推荐给大家！ [quote] 执笔勾墨色，挥毫著文章；阳春布德泽，璞玉生光辉 欢迎关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44174077/]吟遊诗人的手札[/url]，书游戏特色，写游戏魅力 [/quote]

This game was really fun but the more I played it, the more I realized that it doesn't feel like a full game yet. I would be more forgiving if it was released under early access but as a "full release" I don't think I can recommend this yet. Reasons: 1) As a Rogue like/rogue lite it fails on the fundamental aspect of each run feeling different from each other. All the perks feel and play the same and you will almost always end up having a mixture of all of them at the end anyway. Each character doesn't feel distinct from each other. the most different feeling character was the Little Girl that could do a follower build but in the end you'll probably just use a car anyway instead of using your followers. Once you finish a run with 1 character, you've already finished the game with all of them because 80% of the time, you'll play the other characters the same as how you played the starter character. 2)Performance dips from time to time, specially once you finish a run. This wasn't too bad but it just added to the unfinished feeling. Some of the setting such as the auto aim and auto shoot is unplayable at the moment since it will kill you. I have died several time trying this setting on because my rocket launcher would shot a car next to me and cause me to die in the process. 3) The game feels way too easy. Before you start a run, you are given the choice to upgrade your character passive skills and weapons to help you throughout your run like a standard rougelite. But the problem is before you can even max a character out, you have probably already beaten a game with that character already. For example, I never got to test the lazer gun? (I'm not sure cuz i didn't do a run after completing the character) for the Astronaut because beat the game on that character before even getting the chance to unlock it. Overall I think that Maniac was an overall good direction towards innovating the arena roguelike genre that vampire survivor started. It was fun, it forced the player to find upgrades instead of leveling up to get them, and it wasn't a procedural generated map. But it was an incomplete game on full release.

This game combines the top-down perspective of early Grand Theft Auto and Grand Theft Auto 2, but in a more accessible way. The first few runs feel pretty fun and fast-paced, especially before you start worrying about upgrades. However, the more you play, the more flaws become apparent—issues you simply won’t notice within the refund window. Shooting is extremely inaccurate. Maybe that’s intentional, given the chaotic nature of the game, but it makes high-damage weapons like sniper rifles almost useless. Constant clipping issues and missed shots make the shooting experience downright frustrating. In the early runs, you can get bombs as an option, but after upgrading, they stop appearing entirely. Is this a serious bug? The more you play, the more you realize bombs are actually the most effective tool in the game. Once the military shows up in later stages, stealing military vehicles becomes a nightmare. The progress bar to enter them is way too long, and you often die before getting in. On top of that, regular firearms can deal full damage to armored vehicles like APCs and tanks. This is completely illogical. You’re clearly drawing inspiration from Grand Theft Auto, not a WWII RTS. Even if chaos is the goal, why do guns deal 100% damage? There should at least be some damage reduction—right now, heavy vehicles feel pointless. To get money for upgrades, you have to take risks and pick it up manually. There is an upgrade that increases the pickup range, which feels like it’s borrowed from mobile games. But the real problem is that money doesn’t drop immediately after explosions—it appears with a fatal delay, which often gets you killed. All of this makes the game only slightly enjoyable. You’re forced to take unnecessary risks just to afford upgrades, often dying before making any meaningful progress. And even if you push through to the end, the rewards feel underwhelming. With only one map and six unlockable characters, the content also feels very limited. Conclusion: Buy with caution. You’re better off playing Grand Theft Auto or other roguelike games. 结合了GTA1、2俯视的操作但更友好，前面几局还算爽快，没有考虑要升级的时候很好玩。但是玩的越多，游戏的缺点越多，这是可以退款前体验不出来的 1. 射击很难打准，可能这是游戏的特色，毕竟是在一片混乱中，但这让狙击枪的高伤害几乎发挥不出来，无止尽的穿模、未命中，让射击体验糟糕到极点 2. 前面几局还可以拿到炸弹的选项，升级之后就不再出现？这是否是一个恶性bug？玩的越多就会发现炸弹才是最好用的。 3. 后期有军队之后，抢劫军车的进度条非常长，经常是死在上车之前，并且枪械可以对装甲运兵车和坦克造成伤害，这简直是最反逻辑的事情，你模仿的游戏是GTA而不是其他二战RTS题材游戏。好的就算作者你追求的是混乱，那么为什么枪械可以100%的伤害？哪怕减免一些呢，这让重甲车辆形同摆设 4. 为了拿到升级用的钱，必须冒着风险去捡，一项升级可以扩大捡钱的范围，感觉是借鉴了某些手机游戏，但是钱出现的时间并不在爆炸的一瞬间，而是有一个致命的延迟！！！ 以上几点让这款游戏感觉，爽但只爽了一点。为了升级不得不冒着一局玩不了多久去吃屎，想通关最后发现升级的奖励少的可怜。在只有一张地图的情况下，又有6个可解锁的人物。 结论就是：慎买，不如去玩GTA和其他Roughlike游戏

Yes, this is cheap. But I still can't exactly recommend it. There just isn't any depth. The first 60 seconds will be exactly the same as after you've played an hour or two -- if you make it that long. Ignore the marketing about "roguelike". Yes, it has characters you can unlock and abilities you can upgrade. But unlocking characters is surprisingly tedious (only 24% of Steam players have unlocked even a single character!) and the powerups feel meaningless? On my second run (i.e. after playing about 10 minutes) I was causing more death & destruction than I have on play-throughs an hour later after spending thousands upgrading my Santa. There is technically a "goal" of lasting 20 minutes, at which point they drop a nuke on you. As an open sandbox of "murder things until you get bored", this achieves that. But there's no direction, no goal, no progression. And even though it is dirt cheap, it is pretty clear from looking at Steam Achievements that the overwhelming majority of people who have bought this game get bored of the mindless sandbox pretty quickly. Just look at the Steam Achievements: "Infamous" (i.e. play 10 times) 23.9%; kill 100 people (which you can do in about 10 minutes of gameplay): 56.3%; steal a firetruck (you can do this in the first 5 minutes) 38.3%; kill 1000 people (takes about 1 hour of playing: 36.6%. It is pretty clear that the vast majority of people get bored in under an hour, often in under 30 minutes. It not that the price is "too much" for 30 or 60 minutes of fun. But you could spend that time and money on a game that just has a bit more going on.

I don't really know what kind of evaluation to give this game. Consider it a "meh" instead of a "negative". During my second run, I unlocked 3 characters, and there's 6 of them. The game is a real homage to the GTA games of my childhood - the ones before GTA IV. I don't remember ever getting bored while playing these games, and it was not very hard to destroy everything on your way. Too bad the games that followed chose to be hyper-realistic. Fortunately for us, MANIAC is here and it's just that. The enjoyment you'll get from the game pretty much boils down to how much do you like to inflict damage. I liked it, but then I thought it was a little boring; it's always the same thing. I wish the game had more mechanics and content. You'll say: "it's just a 5 euros game, what did you expect?" but I honestly would have paid a little more for a little more content. These 20 minns until the bomb feel a little long because there's little variation, especially for the upgrades that are mostly stats upgrades. There's no funny build to create. The game is not bad though: it's (mostly) just repetitive. And I gotta mention the cruelty of the game, well hidden behind its cartoon graphics, because the game basically asks you to kill young children, mothers with their babies, etc. It reminds me of the game "Hatred" without the dark sasuke vibe and a top coat of cartoon aesthetics. We're in April 2026 and it's fair to assume there won't be any more update for this game. Which is, once again, too bad - because I've encountered a few bugs, for instance the mouse wheel/zoom mechanic completely stopped working.
